label: AIP 507 sunsets GHO Umbrella: emissions end, deficit offset raised to 3M GHO
note: href is the AIP text in aave-dao/aave-proposals-v3 (pinned commit), identical to the on-chain IPFS document: it sets stkGHO Target Liquidity to 1 GHO (protocol minimum) and maxEmissionPerSecond to 0 (reward disabled), and raises the GHO Deficit Offset from 115,000 to 3,000,000 GHO so deficits are absorbed by the DAO before any slashing while stakers unwind; future GHO reserve deficits are covered by the DAO Treasury. On-chain proof (read 2026-10-19): Aave Governance V3 0x9AEE0B04504CeF83A65AC3f0e838D0593BCb2BC7 getProposal(507) returns state 4 (Executed), ipfsHash 0x2cf62185...edbf17 = QmRNAKxc5VqLT8qhYZrHSK8EbUtbFc3czxPbonNfLr4buY, and payload 458 on PayloadsController 0xdAbad81aF85554E9ae636395611C58F7eC1aAEc5; getPayloadById(458) returns state 3 (Executed), executedAt 1785163247 (2026-07-27 14:40:47 UTC). Implements TokenLogic's ARFC (https://governance.aave.com/t/arfc-umbrella-parameter-update-target-liquidity-and-emission-optimization/25154), whose Snapshot vote closed 2026-06-26.
